```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Fetch latest community post
        id: fetch
        run: |
          # Fetch the latest topic list from the community category
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/c/community/l/latest.json)
          # Extract the first topic's ID and title
          TOPIC_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.topic_list.topics[0].id')
          TITLE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.topic_list.topics[0].title')
          # Fetch the full topic data to get the raw content of the first post
          POST=$(curl -s https://discuss.layer5.io/t/${TOPIC_ID}/json)
          CONTENT=$(echo "$POST" | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')
          echo "title=$TITLE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "content=$CONTENT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Prepare archive file
        env:
          TITLE: ${{ steps.fetch.outputs.title }}
          CONTENT: ${{ steps.fetch.outputs.content }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          DATE=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
          FILE=".github/meetings/archive/${DATE}.md"
          echo "# ${TITLE}" > "$FILE"
          echo "" >> "$FILE"
          echo -e "$CONTENT" >> "$FILE"
          echo "FILE=$FILE" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git add "$FILE"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "Update meeting minutes: ${{ steps.fetch.outputs.title }}"
            git push
          fi
```
